country_event = { 
	id = AI_Pulse.010
	title = no_localisation
	desc = no_localisation
	picture = MEIOU_AND_TAXES_eventPicture
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	immediate = { 
		hidden_effect = { 
			every_country = { 
				limit = { 
					AND = { 
						num_of_cities = 1
						NOT = { 
							tag = AAA
						}
					}
					ai = yes
				}
				clr_country_flag = AI_Pulse
				if = { 
					limit = { 
						has_country_flag = PriorityTag
					}
					set_country_flag = AI_Pulse
				}
				else_if = { 
					limit = { 
						num_of_cities = 4
					}
					AAA = { 
						trigger_switch = { 
							on_trigger = has_country_flag
							notbiannual = { 
								PREV = { 
									if = { 
										limit = { 
											AND = { 
												check_variable = { 
													which = rht
													which = rie
												}
											}
										}
										set_country_flag = AI_Pulse
									}
								}
							}
							biannual = { 
								PREV = { 
									if = { 
										limit = { 
											NOT = { 
												AND = { 
													check_variable = { 
														which = rht
														which = rie
													}
												}
											}
										}
										set_country_flag = AI_Pulse
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = { 
					AAA = { 
						trigger_switch = { 
							on_trigger = has_country_flag
							triannual1 = { 
								PREV = { 
									if = { 
										limit = { 
											AND = { 
												check_variable = { 
													which = rht
													which = ric
												}
											}
										}
										set_country_flag = AI_Pulse
									}
								}
							}
							triannual2 = { 
								PREV = { 
									if = { 
										limit = { 
											NOT = { 
												AND = { 
													check_variable = { 
														which = rht
														which = ric
													}
												}
											}
											AND = { 
												check_variable = { 
													which = rht
													which = rid
												}
											}
										}
										set_country_flag = AI_Pulse
									}
